verdict.rationale: Hightouch syncs audiences to ad platforms and engagement tools such as Braze, with match-booster identifiers for ad audiences. Its CDC engine sends only rows that were added, changed, or removed, which covers members entering and exiting. Syncs run on a schedule, on a trigger, or when data changes, and marketing pages claim "real-time" sync to 300+ destinations. Missing for 10: documented latency figures or streaming audience membership showing near-real-time behaviour (current evidence describes warehouse-run schedules and triggers), and independent or hands-on corroboration of continuous audience refresh to ad platforms.
